RECOVERY.the_route_is_real_as_far_as_the_line: review_cycles.create_line:1495 'create or recover the one persistent line for Authority and Work', with line_id derived from authority_uuid and work_id only; _same_assignment:1186 compares authority/work/generation; attach_review:2125 gates on frozen checkpoint, profile, assignment, producer line and INDEPENDENCE. None compares Job ID, so admission, claim and line recovery are NOT where a review-only Job stops.
RECOVERY.the_first_blocking_invariant: attach_review:2168 refuses unless line['state'] == 'review-ready', and a successful attach sets the line to 'reviewing' at :2206 -- BEFORE the container runs. The faulted review therefore already consumed the review-ready state. The only write of 'review-ready' is at :2114 inside freeze_checkpoint, so a line becomes review-ready again only by FREEZING A NEW CHECKPOINT. No detach, abandon_review, release or reopen entry point exists; the abandonment family is abandoned_correction_of/restore_abandoned_correction and the latter returns a line to CORRECTION-ready (:3648), not review-ready.
RECOVERY.minimal_missing_capability: one supported operation that, for a line in 'reviewing' whose attached review attempt ended without a verdict, returns it to 'review-ready' against the SAME current checkpoint, preserving the frozen checkpoint, the producer's writer identity and revision, and the failed attempt's independence record as history. It is the direct analogue of restore_abandoned_correction, so this is a review-side counterpart of an operation the product ALREADY HAS -- a materially smaller claim than 'no adoption path exists'. Not built and not proposed as product work here.
RECOVERY.the_one_unread_fact_that_decides_it: whether the attachment actually committed. I INFER the line reached 'reviewing' from the worker having started its exchange protocol, which means the manager had already attached. I did NOT read the store to confirm the line's current state, because that is a raw-store read nobody authorised. If the attachment did not commit, the line may still be review-ready and a review-only Job may attach with NO new capability. A supported read-only inspection should settle this before anything is selected.
RECOVERY.not_traced: ending, publication and receipt attribution for a review-only Job. The line-state gate is only the FIRST thing it hits; I am not claiming the rest of the route is clear.
